package main

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestPrivateFixtureDirectoryAndSealedState(t *testing.T) {
	directory := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "private-state")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("existing private directory accepted as new")
	}
	path := filepath.Join(directory, "state.json")
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := makePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		file.Close()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(path); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("file accepted as private directory")
	}
	if err := validatePrivateFile(directory); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("directory accepted as private file")
	}
}
